notes.title: Oculus Performance Update and Quest Support
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35943371/f401d2b2439d2987e986986cd597361f5360b73e.jpg[/img]

For those of you wishing to play PAGAN PEAK VR on your Quest, please follow the instructions below:
 
Running Pagan Peak VR on Oculus Quest via Oculus Link cable:

Please make sure to connect your Quest and open the Oculus app before opening Steam VR and ensure that your Quest is detected correctly in the Oculus App. Then start up Steam VR  and launch the game. When prompted to choose in which mode you wish to launch Pagan Peak VR
please make sure you select Oculus VR mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35943371/a0c87ae76966117e3dcc9d5c9866be7807a477a3.png[/img]

[b]WINDOWS MIXED REALITY USERS:[/b]
If you find yourself to be drifting in the game without pressing down the thumbstick please note that this is a hardware issue due to differentiation in manufacturing of the WMR thumbstick. To reduce drifting you can adjust the Thumbstick Deadline Value in Steam VR under:  
Settings->Controllers->Edit Thumbstick Settings


patch notes

notes.title: Performance Update and WMR support
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

This update adds Windows Mixed Reality support and addresses issues 
that some users experienced. In particular:
[list]
[*] Hand movement has now been improved.
[*] Overall performance has been improved.
[*] The grip button on Valve Knuckles controllers can now be used to grab objects.
[*] The visual quality of the "normal graphics" setting for Rift S has been improved.
[/list]
Thanks for playing, stay tuned for more updates and watch out for the
Krampus Killer!
